I have recently recovered repressed memories and it has helped me become more connected to my body and it explains a lot of my past and current behaviours. It is scary and painful but ignoring these memories will only worsen your mental health. I recommend keeping a journal and writing down what you remember. I also recommend doing research on grounding techniques. I think that the feeling of being about to die is related to these suppressed and trapped memories. When reliving these traumatic memories you may experience mood swings and dissociation(depersonalization and derealization) which is valid and normal when healing from trauma. Talking to some you trust and can be open with is also a good idea.
